name: integrations_ai_model_status
description: Show how this workspace's AI model is set up for feedback placement suggestions: whether it is ready (a complete provider, address and model with an API key stored; it does not prove the endpoint answers), the provider, the host of its address, the model id, whether suggestions are on, and whether a key is stored. Never returns the key. Names of people in the workspace are always replaced with placeholders before feedback reaches the model.
